method: Desk research run 5-6 Nov 2026. Candidate pages were discovered with web search in English and in each country's language (Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, Ukrainian/Russian, Vietnamese, Turkish, Hindi/English, etc.), preferring national statistics offices, ministries, customs/export agencies, USDA FAS, the EU and international bodies, then national beekeeper/exporter associations, chambers, trade press and news; market-research vendors only as a last resort (kind 'market_report'). Every page was downloaded with a plain HTTP client (no browser, no login) and each 'quote' was checked programmatically to occur verbatim in the page text (whitespace-normalised; for HTML both with and without separators between inline elements; for PDFs via pdftotext -layout). 'value_as_published' is copied from inside the quote; 'value' is only an exact unit change of it (e.g. 万吨 x10,000, lakh x100,000, 'millones' x1,000,000, decimal commas), explained in 'notes'. Figures published as ranges have value=null plus value_low/value_high; figures published as 'more than'/'about' keep the stated number and say so in notes. When the same figure appears in several reprints the most original reachable page is the source_url and the others go to also_reported_by. Where the original official page could not be reached (login wall, JS-only listing, TLS/DNS failure) a faithful reprint is used and the original publisher is named in 'publisher'/'notes'. status distinguishes official_final / official_provisional / official_estimate / forecast / estimate / reported; is_official is true only when the page's publisher is a government body of that country, the EU, or an intergovernmental body. Coordinator review (6 Nov 2026): figures duplicating official series already collected by Paladex (USDA AMS, USDA NASS, Statistics Canada) were removed; an implausible figure (Cuba) and an ambiguous one (Guatemala) were moved to not_found with the reason.

findings.quote: He mentioned that last year Iran exported 1,870 tons of honey compared to 1,500 tons in the previous year.

findings.publisher: 2merkato.com (Ethiopian business portal), reporting the Ethiopian Ministry of Agriculture
findings.source_title: Ethiopia Exceeds Honey Production Target with 215,000 Tons in Nine Months
findings.quote: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced that Ethiopia produced 215,000 tons of honey in the first nine months of the current fiscal year, surpassing its initial target of 210,000 tons.
findings.notes: First nine months of Ethiopian fiscal year 2024/25 (starts ~8 July); period dates approximate (Ethiopian calendar). Ministry figures are far above independent estimates (often 50,000-60,000 t/yr); treat with caution. Previous full fiscal year 2023/24: over 207,000 t (ENA, 2 July 2024). Exports are small (Addis Fortune: 54 t in a recent year).
